Mission The URI Honors Institute values and creates diverse active-learning approaches, including foundational and experiential learning, insights from national experts via the Honors Colloquium, and policy-rooted education.
It emphasizes integrative learning, connecting disciplines, and supports students’ self-development and self-directed learning through honors-level electives and projects, which can be taken in students’ majors.
The Institute encourages self-advocacy and lifepath learning through fellowship and scholarship applications, empowering students to shape their academic journey.
The URI Honors Institute is designed to create a dynamic learning environment for all students within its scope, encouraging them to engage with and address local manifestations of global issues.
This setting facilitates meaningful interactions with nationally and internationally renowned experts, oﬀering students a unique opportunity to explore major contemporary challenges.

Within the institute, students can actively pursue Honors work in their respective majors, contributing to the overall enhancement of the college experience.
The URI Honors Institute fosters a community of individuals with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and majors, all united by a shared objective: leveraging their talents to address some of the most critical challenges confronting our world.
Within this community, engaged learners are driven by a passion for making meaningful contributions to positive change and sustainable solutions, both within their local communities and on a global scale.
